args.summary: I only got as far as the deploy phase in the stone age open field sandbox. The setup screen is clean and Fight was easy to find. The Line formation preset worked right away. Moving one squad by hand did not work. I tapped the ranged squad's figures, then its banner. Nothing showed it was selected: no highlight, no ring, no change in the panel. Then I tapped inside my zone, and the squad did not move. Either the tap never selected the squad, or the place order failed without any message. At this zoom the units are small and the banners are the only thing big enough to hit. Tapping a squad needs clear, big feedback, plus a hint when a tap selects nothing. The deploy panel covers a third of the screen on the right but reads well. I never started the battle, so I could not judge combat, powers, the economy, sieges, naval or the result screen.

thought: I ran out of steps stuck in the deploy phase, and the missing selection feedback is the main thing for the team to fix.

args.text: Kingdoms sack defense: the battle ended in 43 s. Right after I tapped 2x speed, the raiders withdrew and the result screen appeared. The result screen reads well. It shows HELD, men lost for both sides as bars, XP per regiment, that my general survived, and houses ruined 0 of 23. The battle was too short for me to use the economy HUD, workers, or any real tactics. 'Enemy knights broke' and the army bar (97% vs 66%) made the rout clear. The defense needs a longer or tougher raid, or the speed-up should not finish it before the player can act. Small text on the result screen (the XP footnote, 'Auto is tuned...') is hard to read on a phone.

args.summary: Gunpowder age open field: the setup screen and Fight button were easy to use, and the Line preset worked. Tapping a squad's banner in the deploy phase still gave no visible selection, so I couldn't place a squad by hand. This is the main fix across every session. In battle, the Economy panel is clear and a good size for a finger. Training a Laborer worked: population went from 17 to 18 and 80 food was spent. The laborer counts per resource and the Steward toggle are easy to read, though the population line gets cut off with an ellipsis. The objective box (burn their 7 base buildings) and the army and base bars at the top make it clear who is winning, but the text is small on a phone. Units are small at the default zoom. The banners and health bars are the main things you can read, and the squads crowd together in a line. The panel covers about half the battlefield while it is open. The bottom bar buttons (All, Find, Enemy, Base, Map, Idle, Economy, Select) and the speed buttons are all

thought: The worker trained fine. That was my last step, so I'm ending the session here.

args.summary: Modern walled assault: the setup screen and Fight worked, and the Line preset applied cleanly. Pinch zoom in and out is smooth. Zoomed in, the tanks, infantry and trucks look detailed and are easy to tell apart, but the squad banners disappear at that zoom. Zoomed out, the banners with health bars and unit-type icons are readable, though the icons are small. The army count went from 8 to 10 when the '2 arriving' reinforcements came in, and the Idle button showed this clearly. Combat clarity: the Army and Base bars (You vs Them, percentages) and the objective box ('burn their 7 base buildings, killing their army alone does not end it') explain the win condition well. But the box sits at the top center and covers the city walls, the text is small on a phone, and the enemy walls and gate are hard to pick out from the terrain. Layout and language: the English is clear and the bottom bar buttons (All, Find, Enemy, Base, Map, Idle, Economy, Select), the powers button and the 1x/2x/3x buttons

args.summary: Future sack defense: Fight, the Line preset and Start all worked. The Enemy camera jump showed the raiders straight away. 'Enemy hover tanks broke' and the army bar (99% vs 81%) made the rout clear. The raid ended in 42 s again. I had tapped the powers button, and the result screen came up before I could use a power, so the sack defense is still too short to try powers, the economy or tactics. Please make the raid longer or tougher. The result screen reads well: HELD, they withdrew, men lost for both sides with bars, XP per regiment, my general survived, and houses ruined 0 of 12 with a note that repairs are free. The footnotes are small on a phone. Across this run, the main problems are: tapping a squad in the deploy phase shows no selection, units are small at the default zoom, and the objective box and top chips are crowded and use small text. The bottom bar, speed buttons and Continue button are all big enough for a finger.
